user.title: Set up Navimow
user.description: Enter a name to identify this Navimow account.

auth.title: Link Navimow Account
auth.description: Log in to your Segway Navimow account in the window that opens. Home Assistant will continue automatically once the login is complete.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Navimow
reauth_confirm.description: The Navimow session has expired. Log in again to restore the connection.

abort.already_configured: This Navimow account is already configured.
abort.auth_failed: Authentication failed: unable to retrieve the token.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Navimow servers.
abort.no_url: Unable to determine the Home Assistant URL for the login redirect. Configure it in Settings → System → Network.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different Navimow account than the one configured.
